test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

Issue the advisory to the villagers to be on alert for the cyclone.

options.text: Let the advisory be issued to the villagers to be on alert for the cyclone.
The advisory will be issued to the villagers to be on alert for the cyclone.
Why hasn’t the advisory been issued to the villagers to be on alert for the cyclone?
The advisory might be issued to the villagers to be on alert for the cyclone.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Let the advisory be issued to the villagers to be on alert for the cyclone'.**
